[D20:35] Andrew: Yeah! It's a great way to help the planet and even train our body. Let's give it a try!
[D20:35] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man riding a bike down a street
[D20:36] Audrey: I'd love to try it sometime. Are there any good routes around here?

[D20:40] Audrey: Sounds great! Can't wait to check out those bike routes and soak up the scenery. It should be a blast!
Session date: 4:18 pm on 4 October, 2023
[D21:1] Andrew: Hi Audrey! Been a while since I hear from you. How's it been?
[D21:2] Audrey: Hey Andrew! It's been a wild ride! I did something fun with my pups over the weekend, took them to the beach and it was so fun to see them playing in the ocean.
[D21:3] Andrew: Sounds great! Did they love being at the beach? Did they enjoy the water? Here's a pic of my last trip to the beach.
[D21:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D21:4] Audrey: The dogs had a blast swimming at the beach! Have you been there lately?
[D21:5] Andrew: Haven't been to the beach in a while. Miss being outdoors. It's hard to find open spaces in the city. Used to hike a lot, but it's more challenging now with my work life balance.
[D21:6] Audrey: Oof, that's rough. I can imagine how much you miss being outdoors and surrounded by nature.
[D21:7] Andrew: Yeah, it's been tough. Exploring nature was my escape - a way to find peace. But with my job and living here, it's been harder to get that feeling back. I feel a void in my heart.
[D21:8] Audrey: Yeah, I get how it's like something is missing without being in the nature. But there are still some ways to appreciate it in the city, like getting some plants for your place or taking a trip to the park on the weekends.
[D21:9] Andrew: Yeah true. I should get some more plants for my house. Can't beat being outside tho, but they can still bring some peace. I'll look into it. Thanks for the tip!
[D21:10] Audrey: Of course! If you need help or advice, just let me know. Plants can make your home so peaceful.
[D21:11] Andrew: Thanks! I'll definitely reach out if I need any help or advice. Thanks again for offering!
[D21:12] Audrey: No problem at all! Glad to be of assistance.
[D21:13] Andrew: Oh you've helped so much. 
[D21:14] Audrey: Haha i'm just doing what I can do to help.
[D21:15] Andrew: Thank you really. Well, take care and say hi to your dogs for me.
[D21:16] Audrey: Haha I will. Take care. Talk later!
[D21:17] Andrew: Yup, have a great week. 
[D21:18] Audrey: Have a great week! Bye!
Session date: 9:41 pm on 6 October, 2023
[D22:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew, I was thinking about what you said about missing nature the other day. It reminded me of when I couldn't walk my dogs because of a knee injury. It was tough 'cause they bring me so much joy. This pic was taken after I started walking again. It felt great to be able to get back out there!
[D22:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth
[D22:2] Andrew: You know how it feel right? Bummer not being able to take them for a stroll. They must've been over the moon when you could finally take them out again. Glad you got that adorable pic too! Dogs are awesome like that, huh? Remind us to stop and smell the roses.
[D22:3] Audrey: Yeah, it was like they couldn't wait! They definitely reminds us to appreciate life's little pleasures. They see the world so differently!
[D22:4] Andrew: Yeah, dogs sure know how to find the simple joys of life! Appreciating the little things is so important. Well speaking of interesting hobbies, I rememver you mentionoed about that jewelry earlier? I remember you saying you make them with recycled objects. That sounds cool - tell me more!
[D22:5] Audrey: Oh yes! I love making jewelry out of recycled stuff. It's a great way to show my love of creativity and sustainability. I hunt down things like bottle caps, buttons, and broken jewelry, and then turn them into one-of-a-kind pieces. Here's a photo of one of my favorite necklaces. They all hold a special story and have their own appeal. Plus, it's a small step in reducing waste.
[D22:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman with a colorful necklace and earrings
[D22:6] Andrew: That necklace looks awesome! The colors really stand out and the design is really cool. It's great that you're giving recycled objects new life. Do you make jewelry to sell or just as a hobby? Also, do you donate profits to a good cause?
[D22:7] Audrey: Thanks! I started making jewelry as a hobby and then started selling it. I donate a portion of my profits to a cause that's close to my heart. It's a way to combine two of my passions - making jewelry and making a difference. It's great that customers not only enjoy my work but also support a cause!

Session date: 8:32 pm on 3 July, 2023
[D10:1] Audrey: Hey! It's been a while. I'm taking a dog training course and it's challenging but rewarding. My dogs are doing better already. What's new with you?
[D10:2] Andrew: Hey great to hear from you! Life's thrown me a few curveballs lately. Still can't seem to find any dog-friendly spots to rent. That's a bummer. Have you been able to do any exploring on new trails?
[D10:3] Audrey: Aw, sorry about the search for dog-friendly spots. I haven't had a ton of time for new trails either. The dog-training course has been a big time sink but it's paid off because they're doing great.
[D10:4] Andrew: That's great news! It must feel so rewarding to see them doing well. I understand how it feels on missing the peace of being out on the trails, but for now, it's just urban adventures then.
[D10:5] Audrey: Seeing them do well is super rewarding! They give me so much love and happiness. I get how frustrating it can be not to find pet-friendly spots. Nature is so calming and restorative with them around. See how happy they are when they're out.
[D10:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth
[D10:6] Andrew: I don't think I ever asked what breed they are right? Also, what do they enjoy doing the most? Looks like they're having a blast!
[D10:7] Audrey: They're all mutts. Two of them are Jack Russell mixes and the other two are Chihuahua mixes. They love running and playing fetch, you should see them sometimes.
[D10:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs curled up in a dog bed
[D10:8] Andrew: They look so comfy in that bed. It's clear they're well loved. How old are they? How are they getting along now?
[D10:9] Audrey: They're all 3-year-old and they are a great pack. We had a doggy playdate last Friday. It was a bit crazy but still lots of fun!
[D10:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs laying on a couch with a blanket
[D10:10] Andrew: They look adorable! Doggy playdates sound like a lot of fun. Glad they all get along.
[D10:11] Audrey: Thanks! They really are my universe. So anything new you've been into lately?
[D10:12] Andrew: Lately I've been finding new hobbies since I can't hike. I've been getting into cooking more and trying out new recipes - it's been enjoyable. Do you enjoy cooking? Any favorite recipes?
[D10:13] Audrey: I love cooking! My favorite recipe is Chicken Pot Pie. It's so cozy and delicious, especially on a cold day. If you want, I can share the recipe with you.
[D10:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a pie on a wooden board with a knife
[D10:14] Andrew: Mmm that looks nice! Mind sharing the recipe so I can give it a try? What inspired you to make it?
[D10:15] Audrey: Sure! Let me send you the recipe in a bit. You really should give it a try! It's my family's recipe that's been around for years. The flavors always remind me of my grandma's kitchen - makes me think of all the conversations we used to have at the table. I hope you like it! Oh, and how's the cooking going?
[D10:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a pie with a lattice on top of it
[D10:16] Andrew: Thanks! I'll give it a try. Cooking has been helping me de-stress and be creative. I'm still a rookie, but I'm having fun experimenting. So what makes you like cooking so much?
[D10:17] Audrey: I love trying out new recipes and experimenting in the kitchen - it's like an escape for me. It's great for de-stressing and letting my creativity flow.
[D10:18] Andrew: Oh I feel you! It gives me an escape and allows me to try something new. Plus, there's always the bonus of enjoying the food afterwards. It's slowly becoming one of my favorite hobbies, as it's really relaxing and allows me to express my creativity.
[D10:19] Audrey: Agreed! Cooking and eating the food is so rewarding; it's like a form of self-care. I love throwing on some music, pouring a glass of wine, and just going with the flow in the kitchen. It's so therapeutic. See how beautiful this dish is?
[D10:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a plate of food with a lot of vegetables
[D10:20] Andrew: Ooo, that looks great! Cooking can be so calming, right? What's your go-to ingredient in the kitchen?
[D10:21] Audrey: Yeah! Cooking is definitely calming. Garlic is my go-to ingredient. I love the smell and taste it adds to dishes.
[D10:22] Andrew: Garlic is indeed delicious! Do you have a favorite dish that you like to make with it? If so, would you like to share the recipe?
[D10:23] Audrey: Sure! Roasted Chicken is one of my favorites - sure I'll send you the recipe in a bit.
[D10:23] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a pan of chicken and potatoes on a stove
[D10:24] Andrew: Wow I can't wait to make it! That looks amazing. What inspired you to make it?
[D10:25] Audrey: I'm glad you're interested! This recipe is based on my love for Mediterranean flavors. It's a tasty dish that's easy to make and loaded with healthy stuff like chicken, garlic, lemon, and herbs. It's my favorite comfort meal!
[D10:26] Andrew: Wow, that sounds delicious and healthy! I'm always looking for new meal ideas, especially ones that are healthier. Really appreciate you sharing this with me, thanks!
[D10:27] Audrey: No problem! I hope you enjoy making and eating it. Let me know how it turns out!
[D10:28] Andrew: Yep, will do! I'll keep you posted. Talk later!
[D10:29] Audrey: Excited to hear about it. Talk later!

Session date: 4:22 pm on 13 October, 2023
[D23:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey, it's been a busy week for me. Last Tuesday, my gf, Toby, and I had a really awesome night playing board games. It was really nice. What's been up with you lately?
[D23:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog sitting at a chess board with a chess set in front of him
[D23:2] Audrey: Hey! Sounds like you've been busy! I made some goodies recently to thank my neighbors for their pup-friendly homes. It was a nice way to bring some joy around here. Any plans for the weekend?
[D23:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a pan of cookies on a wooden table
[D23:3] Andrew: Friday night's board game session was a nice break. This weekend, I'm planning to check out this cozy cafe and hang out there.
[D23:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people sitting at a table in a room
[D23:4] Audrey: That cafe looks really cozy! Any other spots you would recommend?
[D23:5] Andrew: So this new spot just opened the other day. It's awesome with a sick view and vibe.
[D23:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man sitting on a couch in a large open space
[D23:6] Audrey: Wow, looks great! Can I bring my pups with me?
[D23:7] Andrew: Hmmm, not sure if it's suitable for them but hey, there's a great dog park close by! Maybe we can bring our coffee over.
[D23:8] Audrey: Sounds good! Exploring new places is always an adventure for them.
[D23:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog wearing a sweater sitting in the grass
[D23:9] Andrew: Aww, they look so sweet in that sweater! Do they enjoy going to the dog park?
[D23:10] Audrey: The dog park is like paradise for them! They love socializing with the other pups and getting lots of exercise. It's so cute to watch them running around and smelling all the stuff. Do you have any funny stories about your pup at the dog park?
[D23:10] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs playing with a frisbee in a field
[D23:11] Andrew: There was this one time my pup got too excited and chased a squirrel. He ran around the tree and the squirrel just watched from the branches. It was hilarious!
[D23:11] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog playing with a frisbee in a field
[D23:12] Audrey: Haha, that must've been hilarious! What breed is your pup again? He looks so fun! My dogs love running around the park. But one thing they hate is snow. I took them to a snowy one last winter and they were so confused! They definitely prefer nice, sunny days in the grass.
[D23:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog wearing a shirt standing on a hardwood floor
[D23:13] Andrew: My pup Toby is German Shephard and loves cute sweaters! He's so active. What games do your dogs like to play at the park?
[D23:14] Audrey: My dogs go crazy for Fetch and Frisbee, and they love to run around and meet other pups. They could keep running for hours!
[D23:15] Andrew: That sounds like so much fun! It's great to see them happy and active.
[D23:16] Audrey: Yeah, it's awesome! Seeing them happy fills my heart with joy. They bring me so much happiness.
[D23:16] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog and a teddy bear sleeping on a couch
[D23:17] Andrew: Yeah, they really do bring joy don't they. It's wonderful.
[D23:18] Audrey: I think i've said this so many times, but I really can't imagine my life without them - my little family. They always make me smile and give lots of love and companionship. Remember I had a tattoo of my four dogs? So I went to the tattoo parlor and got some more drawings on the tattoo.
[D23:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a tattoo of a flower on a wrist
[D23:19] Andrew: Wow, that's cool! Any plans on getting more? Or are you finished?
[D23:20] Audrey: Thanks! I think right now its enough. Unless someday I decide to get another dog. Maybe I'll get another tattoo when that happens.
[D23:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman with a tattoo of a dog and sunflowers
[D23:21] Andrew: I can tell they're a real source of love for you. It's great to have that kind of inspiration. You know what else inspires me? Somewhere like this
[D23:21] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a path in the woods with a forest in the background
[D23:22] Audrey: They really bring me joy. It feels great to experience unconditional love! Do you ever get the chance to visit forests like that? Bet it's an amazing escape for you.
[D23:23] Andrew: Yeah, living in the city, I do miss nature a lot. Whenever I can, I try to go to nearby parks or on hikes. It's such a peaceful and joyful experience for me.
[D23:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman walking up a steep hill with a view of the ocean
[D23:24] Audrey: Yeah you're so right about needing nature time. Life's been crazy lately so it's been a while since I took my furry friends out for a walk. But those moments with them in nature are just so chill and happy! They're definitely the best companions for exploring the great outdoors.
[D23:25] Andrew: Totally agree! Nature and animals can be so peaceful and joyful. I hope you and your furry buddies go on some fun adventures soon!
[D23:26] Audrey: Yeah, I need to go on a hike with them, it's going to be a great therapy!
[D23:27] Andrew: Yeah! You've hiked with your dogs, it's a fun way to bond and make memories.
[D23:28] Audrey: Yup, I still remember everytime we all go on a hiking strip with my dog. Good times.
Session date: 6:12 pm on 19 October, 2023
[D24:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew, hope you're doing ok. I recently had a good week - I went to a pet store last Monday to buy toys for my dogs and it was great seeing them so excited when I got them home. It made me realize how much I love them and how much joy they bring me.
[D24:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a box filled with toys and other items
[D24:2] Andrew: Hi Audrey! Pets really can make our lives better, huh? Speaking of which, I've got some awesome news -- I recently adopted another pup from a shelter. He's the best.
[D24:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog sitting on a couch with a bowl of food
[D24:3] Audrey: Wow! That's awesome news! How's he doing in his new home?
[D24:4] Andrew: Thanks! He's doing great in his new home. Still getting used to Toby and the new environment. Toby needs some time to get along with him too. I never imagined having pets would bring so much happiness. Pets really bring lots of joy and companionship to our lives.
[D24:5] Audrey: That's awesome! What is his name?
[D24:6] Andrew: I named him Buddy because he's my buddy and I hope him and Toby become buddies!

Session date: 5:53 pm on 24 September, 2023
[D19:4] Audrey: I petted and hugged her, spoke calmly, and slowly walked her to relax. Our bond feels even stronger when moments like these show up.

[D19:13] Andrew: Aww, they're all so cute! So much fluff and joy!

[D19:14] Image caption (automatic): a photography of three small dogs sitting on a couch with a white fur

[D19:26] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog and a teddy bear sleeping on a couch
[D19:27] Andrew: Must be great having them around, the bond between you and them is awesome.
[D19:28] Audrey: Yeah, they do! They make everything so much better. Can't imagine life without them. They mean everything to me.
[D19:28] Image caption (automatic): a photography of three dogs sitting on a couch with a laptop in the background
[D19:29] Andrew: That's such a lovely picture, Audrey! So cute to see them snuggled up, having fun together. They really bring so much joy to our lives.
[D19:30] Audrey: They really do, bringing loads of love and happiness. They are everything to me.

[D20:4] Audrey: Being in a nature environment is always a great way to relax. For me, taking the doggos out for a walk in the park helps clear my mind and find some peace. It's been tough lately, but it definitely helps.
[D20:4] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a group of dogs sitting on top of a lush green field
[D20:5] Andrew: Aww, they look so cute! That spot looks ideal for them to play. Where did you take them?
[D20:6] Audrey: We took them to the dog park nearby last Saturday. There was a big grassy area for them to play and lots of shaded spots for me to relax. They had a great time!
[D20:7] Andrew: Sounds great! Missing that experience. Can't wait for the coming up hike!
[D20:8] Audrey: Yeah, Andrew! The pups and I are loving it. Being out in nature and checking out new trails with the dogs is so different from being in the city.
[D20:9] Andrew: I think everyone's gotta ditch the hustle and bustle every now and then. It's so refreshing to be in nature.
[D20:10] Audrey: Yep, it's a relief. It's like being a bird and finally flying free. Talking of birds, have you seen any birds up close lately?
[D20:11] Andrew: I've seen them up close and it's amazing how they fly with grace and freedom.
[D20:12] Audrey: Yeah, birds are really amazing! I love how they can fly around and explore. They have a freedom that I wish I had!
[D20:13] Andrew: Agreed! Watching them fly is so freeing and awe-inspiring. It's a great reminder to appreciate nature.
[D20:14] Audrey: Yeah, for sure. It's a great way to appreciate nature. That reminds me that I've been wanting to do some birdwatching. It's really peaceful and calming.
[D20:15] Andrew: Yeah do that! It's really peaceful and calming. It's nice to get away from the city and enjoy nature. Let me know if you need any birdwatching advice, I think I know a thing or two about bird watching. Or perhaps we can all go birdwatching soometimes.
[D20:16] Audrey: Thanks! That's so helpful, I'd love to take you up on your offer. Right now I'm going with this book that writes about bird watching guides. 
[D20:16] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a book with a page of birds and a bird on it

Session date: 2:36 pm on 28 October, 2023
[D26:15] Audrey: Wow, that looks gorgeous! We hope to join you and the furry friends soon!
[D26:16] Andrew: Yeah I really hope your pups can get better and join us soon!
[D26:16] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a man walking a dog on a leash
[D26:17] Audrey: Wow, that trail looks nice! Looks like its dog friendly?
[D26:18] Andrew: Yup! It's close by and it's dog-friendly too, with killer views. Wanna plan a hike soon?
[D26:19] Audrey: Hmmm sure! Let's pick a date and go hike. It should be good!
[D26:20] Andrew: Yay! Does Saturday sound good? We can grab some snacks and have a blast exploring. Because on Sunday I am going on a picnic date with my girlfriend.
[D26:21] Audrey: Saturday works for me! I'm going to bring some snack. Super excited!
[D26:22] Andrew: Can't wait for our nature day with the fur babies! We're gonna have a good time!
[D26:23] Audrey: Going hiking and seeing nature will be awesome. They'll be so happy!
[D26:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog laying on the ground with a view of the ocean
[D26:24] Andrew: I bet! Where do you guys plan to explore?
[D26:25] Audrey: Let's check out the trail first. It's a peaceful spot to bring the fur babies for the day.
[D26:26] Andrew: Sounds great! There's a lake near the trail too! It's gonna be awesome!
[D26:27] Audrey: Oh nice! Can't wait to explore it and hang out with our furry friends. Should be a peaceful day! Here's a photo of the lake I found online.
[D26:27] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a lake with a boat in it and a forest in the background
[D26:28] Andrew: Wow, that looks awesome! Do you think the dogs will like it? Which trail do you have in mind?
[D26:29] Audrey: Let's try that trail by the lake with great views, perfect for us and the pups. Should be fun!
[D26:30] Andrew: Sounds great! They will love it by the lake. Can't wait!
[D26:31] Audrey: Gonna be great - nature, furry pals - what more could we want? I'm so lucky to have a friend like you who loves exploring and being outside with our dogs.
[D26:31] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog chasing a dog in a park
[D26:32] Andrew: Same! I'm lucky to have a friend like you for these outdoor trips. It's awesome to be out in nature with our furry friends.
[D26:32] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog eating out of a bowl on the ground
[D26:33] Audrey: Yup! It's hard to find someone that has similar thoughts. 
[D26:34] Andrew: Exactly! Oh btw, here's another photo of a trail near the location. What do you think?
[D26:34] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a forest with yellow trees and a blue sky
[D26:35] Audrey: That looks pretty good! I'd love to take them there sometime.
[D26:36] Andrew: How about going there the next trip? The autumn colors are so beautiful!
[D26:37] Audrey: Sounds great! The autumn colors would look awesome for pictures.
[D26:38] Andrew: Yeah, photos are gonna turn out great with the dogs!
[D26:39] Audrey: Can't wait to capture some amazing moments with our furry friends!
[D26:40] Andrew: It definitely will be a memorable day!
[D26:41] Audrey: Yep, can't wait to make some awesome memories with our furry friends!
[D26:42] Andrew: You bet! Can't wait to see their happy face! This was my dog and I when we were hiking last time, see how happy he was?
[D26:42] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a man and his dog on a trail
[D26:43] Audrey: Aww look at his happy face! I'm really looking forward to it! Can't wait to see my pups being happy and hiking.
[D26:44] Andrew: Same here. Let's make it an epic and fun hike!
[D26:45] Audrey: Yep! It's gonna be so much fun.
[D26:46] Andrew: Let me get ready, gonna head out soon. Ttyl!
[D26:47] Audrey: Yep ttyl!
Session date: 7:59 pm on 4 November, 2023
[D27:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey, had a great weekend! My girlfriend and I went on a bike ride and stumbled upon a cool park outside of town. It was awesome to get away from the city and be surrounded by nature.
[D27:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two people riding bikes on a paved path
[D27:2] Audrey: That's cool! I love checking out new parks with my four pups. Last weekend was so fun - our dogs were able to run around and get some fresh air. On top of that, I recently joined a dog owners group to learn how to better take care of them.
[D27:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people and dogs in a park
[D27:3] Andrew: That sounds great! Your four pups must have a lot of fun. How often do you hang out with the dog owners group?
[D27:4] Audrey: Yeah, they're having a lot of fun. I try to meet up with other dog owners once a week for tips from other parents and so they can all play together. How about you? Have you ever thought about joining one?
[D27:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people and dogs in a park
[D27:5] Andrew: That looks fun! Seeing those adorable pups made me think about getting another dog, but I'm still not sure. Having two dogs is already a lot to take care of. Do you have any tips on being a multi-dog pet owner?
[D27:6] Audrey: Maybe you want to take care of Toby and Buddy first. Having them happy and healthy would be a good first step before going all in for more dogs.
[D27:7] Andrew: Thanks, I think that's what I need to hear. I'll take good care of my dogs first.
[D27:8] Audrey: That's great! Let me know if you need any help, I'm here for you! See how happy they are? You don't need more dogs to make them happy! :)
[D27:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs playing with a frisbee in a park
[D27:9] Andrew: Thanks Audrey! That's so nice of you. I think I've managed to make it work with dogs while still living in the city.
[D27:10] Audrey: Yeah I feel you. Taking care of a pup in the city is tough but doable with the right approach. Keeping them active is key. Here's a pic of how I entertain them in my house with toys and games.
[D27:10] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a basket full of stuffed animals on a wooden floor
[D27:11] Andrew: Wow, it's great to know there are ways to keep them active in the city. I'll keep that in mind. Thank you so much!
[D27:12] Audrey: You got it! There are lots of ways to keep them happy in the city. Make sure to socialize and exercise them daily. Get creative and add some mental stimulation too. Here's a pic of them playing fetch in the park - they love it!
[D27:12] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog running with a tennis ball in its mouth
[D27:13] Andrew: That's so cute! What sort of activities do you do to stay mentally stimulated?
[D27:14] Audrey: We give them lots of activities to keep them busy - puzzles, training, hide-and-seek - they love it all!
[D27:14] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog playing with a frisbee in a room
[D27:15] Andrew: Cool ideas! I think I'll give those activities a try with my pups. Thanks!
[D27:16] Audrey: No problem, glad I could help. Let me know how it goes.
[D27:17] Andrew: Your advice and support really mean a lot to me! Thank you so much!
[D27:18] Audrey: That's what friends are for - supporting each other. Your friendship means a lot to me. :)
